pages.title: About KAMPUS
pages.seoDescription: Learn how KAMPUS unifies 21 student workflows into one connected academic platform.

blocks.title: Built Around the Real Student Journey

blocks.body: KAMPUS brings together coursework materials, AI academic guidance, peer study rooms, official campus circulars, career opportunities, and verified student identity passes inside a single cohesive workspace.

items.title: Academic Mastery
items.detail: Study Hub, KAMPUS AI, Notes Exchange, and Smart Planner.

items.title: Connected Campuses

items.title: Verified Trust
items.detail: Encrypted Digital Locker and role-governed data privacy.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.seoDescription: How KAMPUS protects student identity records, private Digital Locker files, and academic telemetry.

blocks.body: Private files stored inside Digital Locker remain strictly isolated to your authenticated student account and are never exposed in administrative bulk exports.

pages.title: Terms of Service

blocks.body: Students must uphold university honour codes when uploading notes, participating in SkillSwap, or listing items on KAMPUS Market.

pages.seoDescription: Frequently asked questions and support resources for KAMPUS modules.

items.title: How do I verify my student account?
items.detail: Open KAMPUS ID or Onboarding to submit your enrollment ID for institutional verification.

items.title: Are my Digital Locker files private?
items.detail: Yes. Only files for which you explicitly generate a timed share link can be viewed externally.

pages.title: Contact KAMPUS

blocks.body: Reach our support team via support@kampus.edu.in or submit an issue ticket from Account > Settings > Help & Support.

announcements.title: Autumn Mid-Semester Examination Seating & Admit Card Instructions
announcements.summary: Admit card downloads open on the academic portal; carry physical Institute ID cards 20 minutes prior to morning and afternoon shifts.
announcements.content:
All undergraduate and postgraduate students registered for Autumn Semester 2026 courses are informed that Mid-Semester Examinations will begin next week across Lecture Hall Complex (LHC 101-304) and Main Building Examination Halls.

1. Eligibility & Admit Cards: Students with cleared fee registration and minimum required course registration status can download their stamped digital admit card.
2. Required Documents: Carry both your printed Admit Card and valid Institute Photo ID Card. Digital screenshots without photo ID are not permitted inside exam halls.
3. Seating Allocation: Room numbers are mapped strictly by Enrollment Number suffix and published in Attachment Circular ACAD/EXAM/2026-41.
4. Prohibited Items: Programmable calculators unless explicitly approved by the course instructor, smartwatches, and mobile phones must remain in designated hall bags.

announcements.title: Last Date for Elective Course Adjustment & Credit Audit Registration
announcements.summary: Semester 5-8 students opting to convert an elective to Audit or drop an extra elective must submit faculty advisor approval before Friday 5:00 PM.
announcements.content:
Students wishing to modify credit/audit status or drop an optional minor/honours elective for Autumn Semester 2026 must submit the signed Credit Adjustment Request via their Faculty Advisor.

Required Steps:
- Verify minimum semester credit floor (18 credits for regular B.Tech students).
- Obtain instructor endorsement if attendance is below 80%.
- Late submissions after the portal window closes will not be processed retroactively.

announcements.title: CS-304 DBMS Lab Batch B2 Rescheduled to Thursday Afternoon
announcements.summary: Due to scheduled UPS firmware maintenance in KReSIT Systems Lab 2, CS-304 Lab Batch B2 shifts from Wednesday 2:00 PM to Thursday 4:00 PM this week only.
announcements.content:
All Semester 6 CSE students enrolled in CS-304 (Database Management Systems) Lab Batch B2 should note that the Wednesday 2:00 PM practical slot is rescheduled to Thursday, 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM in Software Lab 1, KReSIT Building.

Teaching Assistants will evaluate Assignment 3 (B+ Tree & Indexing) during the rescheduled slot. Please upload SQL scripts before Thursday 3:30 PM.

announcements.title: Central Library Reading Halls Extended Until 2:00 AM During Mid-Sem Weeks
announcements.summary: Reading Halls 1 and 2 in the Central Library remain open until 2:00 AM for two weeks ahead of Mid-Semester examinations.
announcements.content:
To support students preparing for Mid-Semester Examinations, Central Library Reading Halls 1 & 2 will stay open from 8:00 AM to 2:00 AM daily starting tomorrow for a 14-day period.

Book circulation counters continue regular hours (9:00 AM to 8:00 PM). Valid Institute ID card verification at the main desk is mandatory after 10:00 PM.

announcements.title: Undergraduate Autonomous Microgrid Research Team Selected for National Finals
announcements.summary: A 5-student interdisciplinary team from EE and CSE qualified for the National Smart Grid Innovation Showcase.
announcements.content:
An interdisciplinary student group from Electrical Engineering and Computer Science & Engineering has advanced to the national finals with their campus microgrid forecasting prototype.

Department demonstration sessions will be held at the EE Seminar Room next Tuesday at 4:30 PM.
